feeds.title: Defrosting Cold Cases
feeds.description: Defrosting Cold Cases is a website with information about unsolved homicides, the missing and the unidentified, wrongful convictions, and book reviews. On here, you'll find articles about old, unsolved cases from the pre-DNA era. They need renewed media attention. The active investigations of these cases is left to professionals.

feeds.title: The New York Times - Forensic Science
feeds.description: News, commentary and archival information about Forensic Science from The New York Times.

feeds.title: The Charles Smith Blog
feeds.description: The Charles Smith Blog began in 2007 after Charles retired from The Toronto Star. Its main goal was to keep looking into the story of a problematic pathologist and the harm caused to innocent parents, caregivers, and Ontario's justice system. The Blog mainly focuses on cases that raise issues in these areas, especially those involving the death penalty.

feeds.title: Forensic's Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to Forensic Science and Legal knowledge. We give information and easy notes related to a fast growing science which helps you in your study and in your general knowledge. Know about the Forensic Science and it's every detail.

feeds.title: Forensic Resources Blog
feeds.description: The Office of Indigent Defense Services provides assistance to North Carolina attorneys litigating complex scientific evidence through its Forensic Resource Counsel. Lawyer Sarah Rackley Olson works with public defenders and private appointed counsel and improves counsel's ability to understand forensic science evidence and achieve better outcomes in their cases.

feeds.title: Forensics and Law in Focus
feeds.description: Dr. Michael Bowers is a dentist and forensic consultant in the U.S. and international court systems. His blog highlights a number of themes relating to forensic science and CSI, include how to give expert forensic testimony as well as how to avoid forensic science malpractice.

feeds.title: In the news by Karen Franklin PhD
feeds.description: Forensic psychologist and professor, Karen Franklin writes about becoming a forensic psychologist, books, The CSI Effect, and forensic science issues.

feeds.title: Forensic Science Academy Southern California Blog
feeds.description: Delve into the gripping and multifaceted universe of forensic investigation, exploring the tools, techniques, and methodologies that decode mysteries and bring truth to light. Forensic Science Academy's blog offers thought-provoking insights and ideas regarding the general scope and nature of Forensic Science.

feeds.title: Sorenson Forensics Blog
feeds.description: Explore the latest updates from Sorenson Forensics and stay ahead in the industry. This blog is your hub for all things happening in the world of forensic science. Discover cutting-edge developments and industry insights right here. Sorenson Forensics is a provider of forensic DNA testing and forensic science services.

feeds.title: Gap Science Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the diverse branches of forensic science, including DNA analysis, ballistics, toxicology, and digital forensics. Gap Science is a must-read blog for forensic leaders! Manage challenging situations, improve team dynamics, and practical tips.

feeds.title: Forensic's Blog » Forensic Odontology
feeds.description: Read the top articles on Forensic Odontology. From Forensic ballistic to Chromatography, these blog posts provide the reader with a complete overview of the forensic science field. Forensic's Blog is a one-stop resource for all who need to keep up with the latest advancements in the field along with other valuable information.

feeds.title: All About Forensic Science
feeds.description: All About Forensic Science is a website designed to help anybody looking for informed and detailed information on this fascinating topic. Essential topics such as definitions, history, topic areas, theory and practice, careers, debates, CSI, degree, and study options are all covered in detail here.

feeds.title: CSAFE Blog
feeds.description: The CSAFE blog provides coverage of cutting-edge forensic science research, practical stories from the field, and forensic-focused events. CSAFE is an organization that brings together scientists, statisticians & other professionals to pursue the common goal of building statistical foundations to apply to forensic science

feeds.title: Forensic Science, Statistics & the Law
feeds.description: Commentary on news and publications at the intersections of scientific evidence, forensic science, and statistics. Intended for people who want accurate information about forensic science and statistical reasoning in the courtroom, this blog mainly features interesting and informed comments on news articles, court opinions, books, and the like that catch the author's eye.

feeds.title: The Forensic Doc Blog
feeds.description: The Forensic Doc Blog covers various questions about forensic pathology, diving into complex subjects and concerns with detailed answers. Find the answer to your question! Author and owner Dr. Chundru is a Forensic Pathologist with more than twenty years of experience investigating deaths and serious injuries.

feeds.title: Arrowhead Forensics Blog
feeds.description: Since 1993, Arrowhead Forensics' mission has been to partner with federal, state, county, and local law enforcement by providing innovative investigation products with excellent service. Our purpose & passion is to create products & solutions that help law enforcement personnel do their job quicker & more efficiently. This forensics blog contains product news and industry information to assist forensic professionals in new and emerging technology.
